title: EndpointDueDiligenceReport
description: The intelligence engine's per-endpoint due-diligence verdict: classification (numeric class_code), risk score across dimensions, the recommended promotion phase (capped by policy + risk + official-docs presence), and the governed uses (teleon_use/baltor_use, allowed data class, executable gating). Advisory metadata — is_truth is always false; Baltor never treats this (or any model output) as truth.

risk_dimensions.description: per-dimension 0..100 (official_docs_confidence inverted into risk, tos_risk, data_retention_risk, free_tier_stability, rate_limit_clarity, key_custody_risk, secret_handling_risk, prompt_logging_risk, intermediary_risk, production_suitability)

provider_node_proposal.description: a PROPOSED model_provider_graph node (status candidate) — NOT written to the graph; agents propose, Baltor disposes
